about: What an enacted policy does to people, by recorded policy question: who it reaches (a selector over people's records), what kind of effect it is (a rule with an enforcer and a penalty, an eligibility, a right, a price or a compliance cost), and who enforces it. Read by src/core2/modules/law-effects.ts when the law takes effect; a repeal ends the effect. Each row is a summary of what such laws typically do, marked as an estimate until the enacted text sets its own terms.

us-policy-positions:justice-public-safet.what: may not buy a handgun from a licensed dealer
us-policy-positions:justice-public-safet.source: Model of state and local laws setting a handgun purchase age of 21 (Giffords Law Center summaries)

us-policy-positions:civil-family-communi.what: may not be refused housing or work for a protected trait
us-policy-positions:civil-family-communi.source: Model of local human rights ordinances (National League of Cities summaries)

us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.paid.what: may take paid leave to care for a new child or a seriously ill relative
us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.paid.employerDuty: fund and grant paid family leave
us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.paid.source: Model of state paid family leave programs (U.S. Department of Labor summaries)

us-policy-positions:housing-land-use.rig.what: has a right to a lawyer when facing eviction
us-policy-positions:housing-land-use.rig.enforcer: the court and the city's legal services office
us-policy-positions:housing-land-use.rig.penalty: none: a service the city funds
us-policy-positions:housing-land-use.rig.source: Model of city right-to-counsel ordinances (National Coalition for a Civil Right to Counsel)

us-policy-positions:environment-energy.b.what: pays a refundable deposit on each beverage container
us-policy-positions:environment-energy.b.enforcer: the state or city environmental agency
us-policy-positions:environment-energy.b.penalty: civil fine for sellers who don't collect it
us-policy-positions:environment-energy.b.source: Model of container deposit laws (Container Recycling Institute)
